async fn run(args: Args) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let cfg = Config::load(args.config.as_deref()).context("loading config")?;
    let store = Store::open(&cfg.data_dir).await?;
    let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<Event>(256);
    let net = Net::spawn(cfg.net.clone(), tx.clone()).await?;
    tracing::info!(room = %cfg.room, peers = net.peer_count(), "daemon started");
    while let Some(ev) = rx.recv().await {
        match ev.kind {
            Kind::Ping => tracing::debug!(from = %ev.author, "ping"),
            _ => store.append(&ev).await?,
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
